title: Nested subscription schedule settings under `default_settings`
summary: On subscription schedules, invoice_settings, default_payment_method, billing_thresholds and collection_method are now nested under default_settings.

migrationNotes.text: Lets you more easily manage the various settings associated with subscription schedules. By nesting the invoice_settings, default_payment_method, billing_thresholds, and collection_method properties under a new default_settings field, the subscription schedule API becomes more organized and intuitive.

sources.quote: | [Nested subscription schedule settings under `default_settings`](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/2019-11-05/nests-subscription-schedule-settings.md) | Billing | Breaking | api |
On subscription schedules, `invoice_settings`, `default_payment_method`, `billing_thresholds` and `collection_method` are now nested under `default_settings`.
